status.current: watches the final after Akatsuki's defeat

relationships.bakuya-tsukikage: Employer figure; she apologizes to him for Akatsuki's tournament losses.

periods.summary: Rinna sits with Sara, Charlotte and Tsukikage at a hidden cafe before the final. After struggling with bitter coffee, she apologizes to Tsukikage because all of Akatsuki lost, but he gently tells her they did their best and asks whether she will help again if needed. After Ikki wins, she declares that her 'Twilight Magic Eye' was right to value him and wants to recruit him as her butler, provoking Charlotte's growl.

key_events.summary: Apologizes to Tsukikage and meets Edelweiss's arrival.
Reacts to Ikki's victory as proof he is worth recruiting.

status.current: promises not to help Rebellion/Akatsuki operations again
status.condition: coerced through threat to her favorite manga

relationships.charlotte-corday: Maid who translates and cares for her.
relationships.kanata-tokutomiya: Acquaintance from elite circles who pressures her to avoid future battlefields.
relationships.bakuya-tsukikage: Family friend she wanted to help by joining the Akatsuki plan.

periods.summary: Rinna attends Ikki's party with Charlotte and eats okonomiyaki while maintaining her chuunibyou persona. Kanata approaches her because the Kazamatsuri family has underworld ties and asks her not to participate in Rebellion actions again. Charlotte explains that Rinna was not a true Rebellion member; she joined as a guest because Tsukikage had been kind to her since childhood. Kanata exploits Rinna's love of the manga Twilight Evil Eye User by threatening cancellation through her family's publishing connection, causing Rinna to immediately promise reform.

key_events.summary: Kanata forces her to promise not to help Rebellion again.

periods.time: After Or-Gaule's destruction of Rebellion headquarters
periods.label: 目击解放军本部惨状的风祭大小姐

status.current: with Kozo Kazamatsuri and Tsukikage at the ruined Rebellion base when SCION approaches

relationships.kozo-kazamatsuri: Father and Rebellion Apostle; she rushes to confirm his safety.
relationships.charlotte-corday: Attendant who helps her through the massacre site.
relationships.bakuya-tsukikage: Visitor whose history-reading is requested by Kozo.

periods.summary: Rinna arrives by Kazamatsuri helicopter at the devastated Alpine Rebellion headquarters with Charlotte and Sara. She is shocked by the severed mountaintops, destroyed gate, and mutilated corpses, then runs to Kozo when she sees he is safe. After Tsukikage uses Moon Heaven Jewel to reveal Or-Gaule's rebellion and the accomplices' plan to destroy Vermillion and Quedland, Rinna remembers that Ikki and Stella said they were going to Vermillion during the Seven Stars celebration, prompting Sara to try calling Ikki. The group then learns phones are down and SCION's Abraham Carter is approaching.

key_events.summary: Witnesses the investigation and realizes Ikki and Stella may be in Or-Gaule's target area.
